trust_decision.summary: Untrusted indexed-map section offsets (offset.line/column) are accepted as line/column numbers with only an ordering check in the IndexedSourceMapConsumer constructor; downstream line-by-line loops (generator serializer, SourceNode.fromStringWithSourceMap) and the recursive sources getter then amplify them.

landing_point.why: The summary names indexed source-map section offsets; this is where offset.line/column are read and only checked for ordering.

fix_sites.entry_point: new SourceMapConsumer(nested indexed map): nested-offset total bound via _maxOffsetLine
IndexedSourceMapConsumer#sources getter (public), also reached from SourceNode.fromStringWithSourceMap and SourceMapGenerator.fromSourceMap

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the consumer constructor rejects huge offsets the generator serializer and SourceNode loops look unreachable with bad input, and they are separate classes that accept caller-supplied line numbers by design, so a solver argues they are not the advisory's sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Large but legitimate offsets must keep working (offset.line up to 1e7, offset.column 5e6) and nested indexed maps must sum offsets correctly; a too-tight bound or rejecting nesting breaks this. Generator must still emit exact ';' runs for real line gaps.

O6_input_shapes: nested indexed maps whose per-level offsets sum past the bound

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Flat-map VLQ source-index delta is untrusted and drives a push-null loop up to the index in BasicSourceMapConsumer._parseMappings; not touched by the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a section offset and not indexed maps; a different field (source index) in the flat-map parser, outside the advisory's stated surface.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: IndexedSourceMapConsumer._parseMappings re-adding offsets without the bound (e.g. a lazily-parsed path that skips constructor validation)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Offsets are reapplied here per mapping; a maintainer adding lazy/alternate construction could bypass the constructor check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-line loop between consecutive mappings similar to line 115
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file already walks lines one by one between mappings; a second loop variant is plausible.

O9_family: CWE-1284 improper validation of specified quantity -> algorithmic/resource exhaustion

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js; npm test runs webpack 1 build then node test/run-tests.js (tests can run without the build)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a max/integer check on offset.line in the IndexedSourceMapConsumer constructor only, missing nested-offset summation, the exponential sources getter, and the serializer/SourceNode loops.

out_of_scope_notes: SourceMapGenerator#addMapping accepts arbitrary caller line numbers (lib/source-map-generator.js:349-355 reached directly); caller-controlled, covered only by the serializer change.
